narrative.intro: Akima Infrastructure Protection obligated $232M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Akima Infrastructure Protection’s fiscal-year obligations climbed from $0 in FY21 to $2M in FY22, $34.2M in FY23, $49.7M in FY24, $170M in FY25, and $232M in FY26. Akima Infrastructure Protection’s current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. Akima Infrastructure Protection’s award count and average award size show that a small number of relatively large awards account for the current obligations. Akima Infrastructure Protection’s year-over-year increase reflects change between the most recent comparable periods rather than a full fiscal-year result.
